entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't give me your script! The whole thing is just **confusing** and **hard to use**. I read the **user manual** twice and it's useless. Honestly, I **expected more** from VeloFit. This is ridiculous. Just process the return.
I understand your frustration. The interface can sometimes feel that way at first. For instance, many users find that customizing the display from the app...

I'm not interested in a tutorial! I paid for a product that should work out of the box. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to a manager? I swear I will leave a one-star review on every website I can find.
No, no, that won't be necessary. I can absolutely handle this for you. My apologies. Let me just pull up your order information to check the policy.

Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago. Let me see... yes, according to our policy, you have 90 days to return the item. So you are well within the window for a full refund.
Finally. Took you long enough. So what's next?

I have just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You just need to package the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at the post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
